entry.title: New: Bill 13 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 24-32, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2025

Appropriates revenues in the Federal Grants – Hawaiʻi County Police Department Pedestrian and Bicycle Safety Grant account ($41,792)

Latest action: Council: Bill 13 passes second & final reading - 2/5/25
